author_action_ledger_entry_shape_check.name: author_action_ledger_entry_shape_check
author_action_ledger_entry_shape_check.value: ("author_action_ledger"."entry_kind" = 'reward' and "author_action_ledger"."reward_key" is not null and "author_action_ledger"."outcome" is null) or ("author_action_ledger"."entry_kind" = 'outcome' and "author_action_ledger"."reward_key" is null and "author_action_ledger"."xp_delta" = 0 and "author_action_ledger"."trust_delta" = 0 and "author_action_ledger"."outcome" is not null)

author_friendships_accepted_at_check.name: author_friendships_accepted_at_check
author_friendships_accepted_at_check.value: ("author_friendships"."status" = 'accepted' and "author_friendships"."accepted_at" is not null) or ("author_friendships"."status" = 'pending' and "author_friendships"."accepted_at" is null)

bug_reports_url_check.name: bug_reports_url_check
bug_reports_url_check.value: char_length("bug_reports"."url") between 1 and 2048 and left("bug_reports"."url", 1) = '/' and left("bug_reports"."url", 2) <> '//'

bug_reports_resolution_check.name: bug_reports_resolution_check
bug_reports_resolution_check.value: (("bug_reports"."status" in ('fixed', 'rejected')) = ("bug_reports"."resolved_at" is not null)) and ("bug_reports"."status" in ('fixed', 'rejected') or "bug_reports"."resolved_by_admin_id" is null)

editorial_document_blocks_shape_check.name: editorial_document_blocks_shape_check
editorial_document_blocks_shape_check.value:
(
        "editorial_document_blocks"."title" is null and (
        ("editorial_document_blocks"."block_type" = 'media' and "editorial_document_blocks"."media_item_id" is not null and ("editorial_document_blocks"."content" is null or char_length("editorial_document_blocks"."content") <= 1000))
        or ("editorial_document_blocks"."block_type" = 'heading' and "editorial_document_blocks"."media_item_id" is null and "editorial_document_blocks"."content" is not null and char_length(btrim("editorial_document_blocks"."content")) between 1 and 200)
        or ("editorial_document_blocks"."block_type" = 'text' and "editorial_document_blocks"."media_item_id" is null and "editorial_document_blocks"."content" is not null and char_length(btrim("editorial_document_blocks"."content")) between 1 and 5000)
        )
      ) or (
        "editorial_document_blocks"."block_type"::text = 'entry_group' and "editorial_document_blocks"."media_item_id" is null
        and ("editorial_document_blocks"."title" is null or char_length("editorial_document_blocks"."title") <= 200)
        and ("editorial_document_blocks"."content" is null or char_length("editorial_document_blocks"."content") <= 5000)
      )

genre_requests_resolution_check.name: genre_requests_resolution_check
genre_requests_resolution_check.value: ("genre_requests"."decision" is null and "genre_requests"."resolved_at" is null and "genre_requests"."apply_status" in ('pending', 'applying', 'failed')) or ("genre_requests"."decision" is not null and "genre_requests"."resolved_at" is not null and "genre_requests"."apply_status" <> 'pending')

quiz_participants_completion_check.name: quiz_participants_completion_check
quiz_participants_completion_check.value: ("quiz_participants"."outcome" is null and "quiz_participants"."completed_at" is null) or ("quiz_participants"."outcome" is not null and "quiz_participants"."completed_at" is not null)

quiz_participants_attempt_state_check.name: quiz_participants_attempt_state_check
quiz_participants_attempt_state_check.value: ("quiz_participants"."outcome" is null and "quiz_participants"."attempts_remaining" > 0) or "quiz_participants"."outcome" = 'correct' or ("quiz_participants"."outcome" = 'exhausted' and "quiz_participants"."attempts_remaining" = 0)

quizzes_content_check.name: quizzes_content_check
quizzes_content_check.value: nullif(btrim("quizzes"."question"), '') is not null or "quizzes"."image_object_key" is not null

title_parts_provider_external_unique.name: title_parts_provider_external_unique
title_parts_provider_external_unique.where: "title_parts"."source_provider" is not null and "title_parts"."external_id" is not null

title_parts_source_check.name: title_parts_source_check
title_parts_source_check.value:
("title_parts"."source_provider" is null and "title_parts"."external_id" is null) or
    (nullif(btrim("title_parts"."source_provider"), '') is not null and nullif(btrim("title_parts"."external_id"), '') is not null)
